<!-- user-release-notes:v2:en -->

## New

Source code and licences of the ESP software used, for developers.

## Fixed

This is source material only: not a firmware file and not a Home Assistant update, so it cannot be installed on a device.

Only meant for developers who want to consult the source code and licence material.

## Limitations

Not an installable device update.
